title: The Dog Door
hook: I house-sat by the lake. The note on the fridge had one rule: keep the dog door latched after dark... no matter what you hear.
lines: I house-sat for a couple out by the lake. Their note on the fridge had one rule.
Keep the dog door latched after dark. No matter what you hear.
Their old golden retriever met me at the door, tail wagging like crazy. I figured they forgot to mention him.
Every night, he slept at the foot of my bed. The first two nights were quiet.
On the third night, I woke up to scratching... and the jingle of a collar... at the dog door.
Then whining. Soft and pitiful. Like a dog left out in the cold.
I looked down. The golden was still at the foot of the bed. Head up. Staring at the hallway.
He didn't bark. He didn't even blink.
The scratching went on until sunrise. Then it just... stopped.
In the morning, I texted the owners. Your dog was so brave last night.
